story_review.one_viewing_summary: Anyone can hail a driverless car at the San Antonio airport. Two empty cars were caught in April floods. The recall wording is acted out on a lane. The record lists the remedy as under development and an interim update reached every car by April 20.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The curb arrival answers back at the same curb, now beside the remedy-under-development record.
story_review.weakest_transition: s2 to s3: map to creek. A different example is introduced only through the disclosure label.
